description: Port the OpenAI-compatible AI advisor to the web (server-side) and ADD a RAG knowledge base grounded in staff-uploaded documents (books, scientific research, etc.) using Neon pgvector. Includes: an AI client + config, the vocational diagnostic report generator and conversational tutor (both server-side so API keys never reach the browser), a knowledge-base ingestion pipeline (chunk + embed documents into knowledge_chunks with pgvector), a retrieval step that injects the most relevant passages as grounding context with citations into the advisor prompts, and a staff admin UI to upload/list knowledge documents. Depends on FEAT-001; complements FEAT-002.
steps: Create web/lib/ai/client.ts: a server-side OpenAI-compatible chat client faithful to app/src/main/java/com/example/data/remote/AiService.kt (dynamic base_url normalization to /v1/chat/completions, Authorization: Bearer <key> when key present, temperature/max_tokens, parse choices[0].message.content, Spanish error handling). Also add an embeddings function (POST {baseUrl}/embeddings) returning number[] vectors. Read provider config from env (e.g. AI_BASE_URL, AI_API_KEY, AI_MODEL, AI_EMBEDDING_MODEL) and/or the ai_config table; never expose keys to the client. Port AiProviderType metadata from AiModels.kt.

Port the two system prompts from AiService.kt into web/lib/ai/prompts.ts: generateVocationalReport (4-section Spanish report using scores, dominantCode, topCareers, reliabilityLevel, optional studentName) and the conversational tutor prompt that carries the student's psychometric context. Keep Spanish wording faithful. Also port buildOfflineFallbackAnalysis as a no-AI fallback.

Add server route handlers: web/app/api/ai/report/route.ts (generate diagnostic report for a session; persist to assessment_sessions.ai_analysis) and web/app/api/ai/chat/route.ts (conversational tutor; accepts conversation history + current diagnostic context). These run server-side only.

Implement the knowledge base ingestion in web/lib/knowledge/ingest.ts: accept a document (title, source_type e.g. 'book'|'research'|'article', optional source_reference like citation/URL, and text content), insert a knowledge_documents row, split content into overlapping text chunks, compute embeddings via the embeddings function, and insert knowledge_chunks rows with the vector(1536) embedding. If no AI key is configured, allow storing chunks with null embeddings and document that retrieval requires embeddings.

Implement retrieval in web/lib/knowledge/retrieve.ts: given a query string, embed it and run a pgvector cosine-similarity search (ORDER BY embedding <=> $queryEmbedding LIMIT k) over knowledge_chunks, returning top-k chunks with their parent document title/source_reference for citation. Guard for the case where DATABASE_URL/embeddings are unavailable.

Wire retrieval into the advisor: before calling the tutor and report prompts, retrieve relevant passages for the user's question / profile and inject them into the system/user prompt as a clearly delimited 'Fuentes de conocimiento' context block, instructing the model to ground answers in and cite these sources (title + reference). When no sources are found or embeddings are unavailable, fall back to the normal prompt.

Add a staff-only knowledge-base admin route web/app/admin/knowledge/page.tsx with an upload form (title, source type, reference, pasted text or file upload) posting to web/app/api/knowledge/route.ts which calls ingest; and a list of existing documents with chunk counts. Keep UI Spanish.

Add an AI settings UI (web/app/admin/ai-settings or a dialog) equivalent to AiSettingsDialog.kt to configure provider/baseUrl/apiKey/model/temperature, persisted to ai_config; and a student tutor chat UI (web/app/tutor or component) equivalent to AiChatScreen.kt that calls /api/ai/chat.
Ensure build/typecheck pass without AI keys or DB (all AI/embedding/db calls lazy and guarded).
acceptance_criteria: AI client, report generator, and tutor run server-side; no API key is referenced in client bundles.
web/lib/knowledge/ingest.ts inserts a knowledge_documents row and multiple knowledge_chunks rows, embedding each chunk when an AI key is configured.
web/lib/knowledge/retrieve.ts performs a pgvector cosine similarity query and returns top-k chunks with document title + source reference for citation.
The advisor prompt injects retrieved passages as a grounding/citation context block when sources exist.
A staff knowledge-base admin page allows uploading a document and lists stored documents.
`cd web && npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` pass without AI/DB env vars set.
findings: Ported the OpenAI-compatible AI advisor server-side and added the RAG knowledge base. NEW MODULES (all lazy/guarded, server-only): web/lib/ai/config.ts (AI_PROVIDERS metadata ported from AiModels.kt: NVIDIA_NIM/OPENAI/LOCAL_AI/CUSTOM; resolveAiConfig() merges env AI_BASE_URL/AI_API_KEY/AI_MODEL/AI_EMBEDDING_MODEL/AI_TEMPERATURE/AI_MAX_TOKENS with the ai_config DB row when DATABASE_URL is set; isConfigured/canEmbed; EMBEDDING_DIMENSION=1536, DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_MODEL=text-embedding-3-small). web/lib/ai/client.ts (completeChat faithful to AiService.kt: base_url normalization via buildChatEndpoint handling /chat/completions, /v1, bare host, https:// prefix; Authorization Bearer only when key non-blank; body {model,messages,temperature,max_tokens}; parses choices[0].message.content; Spanish 'Respuesta vacía recibida del proveedor de IA' + error handling; uses fetch not okhttp; plus embedText/embedTexts POSTing {baseUrl}/embeddings returning number[]). web/lib/ai/prompts.ts (buildVocationalReportMessages = the 4-section Spanish report prompt verbatim; buildTutorSystemPrompt/buildTutorMessages = conversational 'OrientApp AI Tutor' prompt carrying RIASEC psychometric context (AiChatScreen.kt had no literal prompt in source, so composed faithfully to its UI intent); buildOfflineFallbackAnalysis ported verbatim; buildKnowledgeContextBlock formats the 'Fuentes de conocimiento' grounding/citation block). web/lib/knowledge/chunk.ts (pure overlapping chunker, default 1200 chars/200 overlap, breaks on paragraph/sentence). web/lib/knowledge/ingest.ts (ingestDocument: title+sourceType BOOK|RESEARCH|ARTICLE+sourceReference?+content -> inserts knowledge_documents, chunks, embeds via embedTexts, inserts knowledge_chunks with embedding cast $n::vector; if no AI key -> stores chunks with NULL embedding + warning that retrieval needs embeddings; validates embedding dim==1536; listDocuments returns chunk + embedded counts). web/lib/knowledge/retrieve.ts (retrieveRelevantPassages: embeds query, pgvector cosine ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector LIMIT k over rows WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL, joins knowledge_documents for title+source_reference; returns [] when no DATABASE_URL/embeddings/results). ROUTES (runtime=nodejs, dynamic=force-dynamic): web/app/api/ai/report/route.ts (loads session, retrieves passages, injects knowledge block, calls report prompt, persists to assessment_sessions.ai_analysis; falls back to buildOfflineFallbackAnalysis when unconfigured/failed), web/app/api/ai/chat/route.ts (tutor: history + optional sessionId psychometric context + RAG grounding; 503 when AI unconfigured), web/app/api/knowledge/route.ts (POST ingest / GET list). SERVER ACTIONS: web/lib/actions/ai-config.ts (getAiConfigView never returns the key in clear, only hasApiKey; saveAiConfig upserts ai_config id=1, preserves existing key when blank). UI (Spanish): web/app/admin/knowledge (KnowledgeAdminClient upload form + document list w/ chunk counts), web/app/admin/ai-settings (AiSettingsClient provider/baseUrl/apiKey/model/temperature form, key masked), web/app/tutor (TutorChatClient calling /api/ai/chat, suggested prompts from AiChatScreen.kt), AiReportClient wired into results page (on-demand report + 'Conversar con el Tutor IA' link). Nav: added Tutor IA link (layout.tsx); admin page links to Knowledge + AI settings. Added web/tests/knowledge.test.ts (11 tests: chunkText, buildChatEndpoint, buildEmbeddingsEndpoint, buildKnowledgeContextBlock). Updated web/.env.example with optional AI_* vars. SECURITY: verified .next/static client bundles contain NO AI_API_KEY string and NO process.env.AI_* (only the local form-state var name 'apiKey' in the settings form, which is user input). VERIFICATION (all green, no env vars): npm run typecheck OK, npm run test -- --run = 31 tests pass, npm run lint = 0 warnings, npm run build succeeds with DATABASE_URL/AI_* unset (AI + knowledge routes correctly marked dynamic ƒ; /admin/knowledge static, fetches client-side). Runtime AI/embeddings/pgvector behavior could not be exercised (no live Neon/OpenAI creds per sandbox). Embedding dimension kept at 1536 to match schema vector(1536); ingest guards against mismatched dims. Did not modify anything under app/. [REVIEW-FIX 2026-08-29] embedTexts (web/lib/ai/client.ts) now sorts the provider data array by the OpenAI `index` field BEFORE extracting vectors (falls back to arrival order when index absent) and enforces a strict 1:1 vector<->input count, failing on partial/reordered batches to prevent chunk<->embedding misalignment. Added tests/ai-client.test.ts (ordering, missing-index, partial-batch, empty). Documented plaintext ai_config.api_key at rest in README (security note) + db/schema.sql comment + a UI notice in AiSettings, recommending AI_API_KEY env var (which has priority). Knowledge ingest POST now behind the staff-auth guard.
